[attribute-related-article-type]
=== `@related-article-type` Type of Related Article

Type of article being described by the <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>> element.

#### REQUIRED on element:  <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The article type for the related article, for example,
                        “`announcement`”.
| Restriction| This attribute is required; it must be provided if the element is used.
|===
